ctgov.note: All 17 listed sponsor trials are completed legacy sufentanil/DSUVIA/Zalviso studies (divested to Alora Apr 2023); no Niyad NEPHRO study in compact (regulated as device under IDE, not drug NCT)

pipeline.modality: Combination drug-device (Class III medical device per FDA)
pipeline.target: Serine protease inhibitor (regional anticoagulant for the extracorporeal circuit)

indications.indication: Regional anticoagulation during continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) in adult AKI patients
indications.trial_name: NEPHRO CRRT Study (Nafamostat Efficacy in Phase 3 Registrational CRRT Study)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, double-blinded, placebo-controlled; up to 14 US ICUs; n=70; primary endpoint mean post-filter ACT over first 24h
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (registrational); completion expected 2026 per 2025 10-K. PMA submission planned post-completion

excluded_preclinical.reason: Nafamostat IV formulation; IND will be evaluated for submission following toxicology to enable Phase 2 - still preclinical/IND-pending per 2025 10-K

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Divested to Alora Pharmaceuticals Apr 2023; Alora submitted DSUVIA NDA withdrawal in 2025; 17 legacy NCT records all COMPLETED

excluded_legacy_terminated.asset: Pre-filled syringe (PFS) candidates including Fedsyra (ephedrine PFS, Aguettant license)
